title: Complement closure of polynomial oracle time
statement: For any binary oracle language $O$ and any binary language $L$, if $L$ is decidable in polynomial time by a finite oracle Turing machine with oracle $O$, then its complement is also decidable in polynomial time with the same oracle.
hypotheses_covered: $L,O$ are languages over the binary alphabet
